headline: Themes and design.
subheadline: Brand your portal with logo, colors, templates, and dashboards. Mobile-responsive and consistent across roles.

segments.title: Branding
segments.body: Logo, colors, and portal appearance per school. Consistent identity for admin, teacher, parent, and student views.

segments.title: Templates
segments.body: Report templates, form templates, and dashboard layouts. Start from blueprints or customize.

segments.title: Dashboards
segments.body: Role-based dashboards with widgets and KPIs. Configure what each role sees on login.

segments.title: Live previews
segments.body: Preview branding and layout changes before publishing. No surprises at go-live.

segments.title: Mobile responsiveness
segments.body: Portals and forms work on phones and tablets. Parents and staff can use the platform on any device.
